facts.claim: Katikies Chromata Santorini (Imerovigli; '5-Star Luxury Hotel') caldera wording: 'Situated on the island's Caldera, the peaceful Imerovigli village, known as the "Balcony on the Aegean", is dotted with charming restaurants and home to sweeping views and breathtaking sunsets' and 'Delicately pure, essential accommodations bursting with romance come complete with Santorini's mesmerising Caldera views.' Its FAQ says it sits 'on the highest point in Imerovigli, offering 180° views' with 'direct sunset views'. Caldera part only; the wedding part rests on the existing Katikies events fact.

Katikies Chromata FAQ: children above 13 are welcome; top room categories are the Master Pool Suite and the Chromata Infinity Pool Suite; restaurants are Koukoumavlos Restaurant, the Katikies Lounge and an Aperitivo Bar on the top level; about a 5-minute drive from Fira. Room count, wedding capacity and exclusive use not published on this page.

Kapari Natural Resort (Imerovigli; 'our 5-star boutique resort') caldera wording: 'Nestled in the heart of Imerovigli, KAPARI Natural Resort is an exclusive sanctuary where tranquility meets beauty. The resort commands an awe-inspiring view of the caldera' and '17 rooms and suites with incomparable views of the caldera'.

Kapari Natural Resort wedding wording: 'Ceremonies & Receptions: We help you plan and hold your Ceremony & Reception in the setting you've dreamed of, the way you envisioned it. Our helpful resources and event planning team, make it easy to coordinate all the details'; 'Weddings: Trust your special day to us'; hotel services list 'Specialized Wedding receptions/ Honeymoon vacations'. Links to a weddings page at /weddingsceremonies/ (not read in this run). Guest capacity, named ceremony spaces and exclusive use not published on the home page.

Kapari Natural Resort standout: restored traditional Santorini structures combined with modern amenities, plus the Kapari Wine Restaurant ('Unforgettable sunsets await') and in-house massage services. Room types include Honeymoon Suites and 'Kapari Up & High'.

RESERVE (wedding part unmet): Erosantorini, a private estate in Messaria ('One Estate, 5 Suites, Entirely Yours'; 'Up to 10 guests · 2 private acres · Fully serviced · Panoramic Caldera views · Private pool & spa') with a private chapel and wine cellar and an 'Events' heading, but the home page does not state weddings in words.

RESERVE (wedding part unmet in words): Aigialos Luxury Traditional Settlement, Fira (five-star, 15 suites and residences): 'With spectacular views of the Santorini caldera, the volcano, the sunset and the Aegean Sea'. The home page links a 'romance' page at /wedding-honeymoon-santorini/ that was not read, so weddings are not confirmed in words.
Iconic Santorini contact page (Imerovigli boutique cave hotel) lists phone, email and address only and does not mention weddings or events. Still does NOT qualify.

Secret Hotels contact page (Oia; Santorini Secret Premium, Secret Legend Suites, Secret View Hotel in Foinikia) offers a general request form and does not mention weddings or events. Still does NOT qualify.

insider_details.detail: Kapari has 17 rooms and suites and an in-house event planning team, so a small wedding party can stay, marry and dine in one place in Imerovigli; confirm guest numbers and the ceremony terrace with the venue, as capacity is not published.

Katikies Chromata sits on the highest point of Imerovigli with 180-degree, direct sunset views and a top-level Aperitivo Bar, and welcomes children over 13 only, which matters for families bringing younger guests.
